name: Hui Min Environmental Tech Corporation
summary: Hui Min Environmental Tech Corporation operates as an engineering and construction company dedicated to environmental protection, with its core business centered on the production of specialized environmental equipment. The company offers a comprehensive array of machinery, including water screening systems, wastewater degrit equipment, sludge settling units, and various solutions for sludge and organic waste management (dewatering, drying, and carbonizing). Additionally, their portfolio extends to solid conveyor systems, automated food waste separation systems, biological process systems tailored for wastewater treatment plants, and industrial deodorizers, among other related devices. Hui Min Environmental Tech serves a wide client base, extending its operations across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international territories. The company was established on April 8, 1997, and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
